name: SkillRegistry::select

test_list.description: The canonical Noul question is paired with bounded candidate metadata, while bodies are never sent.
An open schema policy uses stable lexical fallback after an engine error.
A closed schema policy returns an error when the decision engine is unavailable.
A schema with the expected ID but extra questions is rejected before invoking the decision engine.
The schema-specific deadline is enforced and its uncalibrated provenance remains visible on fallback results.
Unapproved repository skills are excluded from both selection paths.
Required tools are reported as missing metadata and are never inserted into the available tool set.

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: Bounded task text already prepared by the caller.

output_description: Ranked approved skill metadata only; callers explicitly load bodies after selection.
